Title: Rohan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Rohan - 11 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Shalini - 34 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Meera - 9 years, friend
Look: glasses, blue dress
4. Sharda - 62 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rohan stands in the courtyard. Shalini stands near him.]

Shalini: "What lovely weather!"

[Rohan walks across the courtyard.]

Rohan: "Really?"

[Rohan jumps with joy.]

Rohan: "That's easy."

[Rohan tiptoes across the courtyard.]

Rohan: "Yes, of course."

[Rohan hides behind the tree.]

Shalini: "Good job, Rohan!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Thick fog lies all around. Rohan stands in the courtyard. Shalini stands near him.]

Rohan: "What a nice place."

[The mist slowly clears.]

Shalini: "Hmm, I see."

Scene 3: The living room - Day

Sharda: "Let's begin."

[Rohan lies down on the sofa.]

Rohan (happily): "This is amazing!"

[Rohan flops down on the sofa.]

Shalini: "Okay, Meera."

[Rohan sits cross-legged on the floor.]

Meera (softly): "What a day to remember!"
